title: Amazon Fire TV smart TV (AFTEU014, codename greta), Fire OS 7.6.8.5 (PS7685/4487), Android 9 (SDK 28),
notes:
Amazon Fire TV smart TV (AFTEU014, codename greta), Fire OS 7.6.8.5 (PS7685/4487), Android 9 (SDK 28),
MediaTek m7322, 3 HDMI + DVB tuner, 1.6 GB RAM. Germany.

FIRE OS: DEBLOAT ONLY. Home is com.amazon.tv.launcher/.ui.HomeActivity_vNext (priority 950), with
com.amazon.firehomestarter and com.amazon.tv.settings.v2/.system.FallbackHome behind it; the launcher package is
protected and `cmd package set-home-activity` prints Success but is ignored, so launcher/ does not take Home here.
Amazon's input player and Live TV are closed to other apps (com.amazon.tv.permission.TUNE_INPUT and
com.amazon.tv.livetv.permission.TUNE_CHANNEL; the LAUNCH_INPUTS picker is signature|privileged).
KEYCODE_TV_INPUT_HDMI_1..3 switch inputs from the ADB shell, but not when an app injects them into its own window.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/amazon-fire-tv-afteu014/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/amazon-fire-tv-afteu014/debloat.txt com.amazon.tv.launcher
Everything is DISABLED for user 0, never uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Applied 2026-10-21 in four batches with a screenshot after each, then rebooted: 34 of 35 stayed disabled. Home,
the Live tab with DVB channels, Netflix, Joyn, ZDF and ARD Mediathek open. com.amazon.vizzini (Alexa voice) comes
back enabled at every boot, as on hisense-fire-tv-aftcibfbd1; it is listed anyway and simply does not stick.
Protected on this build ("Cannot disable a protected package"): com.amazon.device.software.ota and
com.amazon.device.software.ota.override, so firmware updates keep arriving, plus the Fire OS 7 set commented below.
Private DNS dns.adguard-dns.com (private_dns_mode hostname) works: doubleclick.net resolves to 127.0.0.1 and YouTube
still plays, but the hero banner and the "Gesponsert" row stay, since they come from the launcher's own feed.
ARD Mediathek registers only LEANBACK_LAUNCHER: start de.swr.ard.avp.mobile.android.amazon/.TvActivity to test it.

Already disabled on this TV before this list (left as they were; restore does not touch them):
com.amazon.tv.acr, com.amazon.hybridadidservice, com.amazon.ftv.screensaver, com.android.nfc,
com.amazon.tv.democontent.provider, com.amazon.sneakpeek, com.amazon.wirelessmetrics.service,
com.amazon.tv.fw.metrics, com.amazon.tv.ottssocompanionapp, com.amazon.tv.alexanotifications,
com.amazon.tv.alexaalerts, com.amazon.shoptv.client, com.amazon.perfcollection, com.amazon.hedwig.

Kept on purpose: Live TV, tuner and HDMI (com.amazon.tv.livetv, com.amazon.mediatek.livetv, com.mediatek.tvinput*,
com.amazon.tv.channelscan, com.amazon.tv.conditionalaccess, HbbTV com.vewd.*), com.amazon.tv.launcher,
com.amazon.firehomestarter, settings, com.amazon.tv.ime, remote/Bluetooth (fireinputdevices, uxcontrollerservice,
autopairservice, bluetoothpa/blepa), Appstore (venezia, tigris), Prime Video (firebat, avod), casting
(cast.sink, dialservice, awvflingreceiver, whisperplay, whisperlink), account and sync, com.amazon.tv.oobe,
accessibility and TTS (logan, ivona), com.amazon.providers.contentsupport (also switches the TTS engine).
Looked at with dumpsys and left alone because their role is unclear: com.amazon.katoch, com.amazon.centrix,
com.amazon.cpl, com.amazon.tifobserver, com.amazon.connectivitydiag, com.amazon.neopactservice, com.amazon.dpcclient.
